title: ID0464805-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / R1 170001380] Dispenser power supply going on-off-on and LEM display not showing values
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Dispenser is toggling on-off-on. After KF212 and KF214 were disconnected, suppy voltage settled down. If KF214 or KF212 was disconnected during power cycle, toggling started again. We suspect either power supply is broken, one of the electronic fuses is broken or short leakage in EcoG circuit.
DC3 LEM meter display doesnt work.
Solution: EcoG power supply moved to under another fuse.
